content.text: {"summary":"You delivered a solid, end-to-end Australian-benefit mission for Great Barrier Reef monitoring that meets all Part 2 deliverables. Your STK evidence, COE table p12, and segment coverage are strong. To lift further, fix the 4 technical gaps on p7, p11, p13, p17 and tighten referencing/formatting.","criteria":{"C1":"You did well framing a clear Australian benefit on p4-5, defining fluid-lensing coral monitoring and justifying a single satellite for CSIRO/BOM users with references. For Accomplished 9-10, deepen literature comparison to existing ocean-color missions and quantify the gap yours fills.","C2":"You covered all segments well: Vega E piggyback from Kourou p9, SSO 600km 97.79deg with COEs p12, STK access p14, and drag-sail EOL. To reach 9-10, add the hand-calculation for p11 SSO inclination, correct RAAN definition p13, and include a delta-V budget for p17 maneuvers/maintenance.","C3":"You summarized launch, orbit, ground station and science goal clearly on p18 and linked back to bleaching. Accomplished is strong; for top of band add specific performance numbers from your design e.g., revisit, coverage % and residual risks.","C4":"You provided a logical structure, executive summary p2, and labelled STK figures p10. To reach higher Accomplished, remove Wikipedia as primary source p7 per instructions, fix bibliography consistency, and proof figures/tables formatting."},"next_steps":["On p11, show full hand derivation i = cos^-1(-2*a^3.5*RAANdot/(3*J2*Re^2*sqrt(mu))) and compare to STK 97.7924 deg for SSO validation.","Correct p13 RAAN concept and on p17 add a simple delta-V budget: direct injection vs maintenance and deorbit, even if zero, with justification.","Replace p7 Wikipedia Timeline with launch provider manual or SpaceflightNow/industry source and standardize references to ensure in-text citations match list."]}
